Problem packs Stable

A problem pack is the unit of competition content on TenkaCloud.

What is a problem pack

Each pack carries metadata, a single-page CloudFormation template deployed straight into a competitor account, and an optional portal plugin.

Battle versus Challenge

  • Battle packs are real-time and head-to-head.
  • Challenge packs are self-paced and evergreen.

Scoring kinds

Scoring uses one of six built-in kinds — flag, multi-flag, uptime-flat, uptime-multi, phased-polling, or attack-detection — one per problem.
